1x3.scope: Untimed original BucketCHMatrix results on a reconstruction of the identical complete shared QueryGraph, before mandatory API verification/correction. Plain upstream Dijkstra is independently instantiated per distinct snapped-node pair on that same overlay. No geometry, path extraction, or original-edge expansion cost is removed from measured API requests.
